name: oscanarinhos
description: Repo-level tooling (git hooks, commit linting, formatting). Each app in apps/ keeps its own package.json and lockfile.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/capi && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/cfe
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/capi && npm run test:ci --prefix apps/cfe
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/capi && npm run lint --prefix apps/cfe
